title: 判定不稳定的 clip 比例

standard.summary: 一个 epoch 里被梯度裁剪的优化步占比超过它，这一轮就算不稳定。默认 0.50，即一半以上的步都被裁。
standard.effect: 只作用于回滚判定，不改变裁剪行为本身；裁剪强度由 max_grad_norm 决定。
standard.whenToUse: 训练本来就长期贴着裁剪线跑（例如高 lr 起步）时上调，避免每轮都判成不稳定。
standard.avoidWhen: 把它调到接近 1 —— 那样基本不会触发回滚，等于花钱留副本不用。

standard_en.summary: An epoch counts as unstable when the share of optimizer steps that hit gradient clipping exceeds this. Default 0.50, i.e. more than half the steps clipped.
standard_en.effect: It only feeds the rollback decision and never changes clipping itself; clipping strength comes from max_grad_norm.
standard_en.whenToUse: Raise it when the run legitimately rides the clip line (for example a high starting lr), so every epoch does not read as unstable.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Pushing it near 1 all but disables the rollback, which means paying for snapshots you never use.

advanced.principle: 训练循环每轮把 optimizer 侧统计的裁剪命中比例（optimizer_update._read_clip_ratio_and_reset）交给 guard，与阈值比较后清零重新累计；两个触发条件（本字段与 norm 涨幅）是「或」关系。
advanced.intervention: epoch 边界的判定，一次浮点比较。
advanced.expectedImpact: 无计算开销，只改变回滚触发频率。
advanced.tradeoffs: log 里能看到 clip_ratio 与 norm_growth 两个实测值，先按日志里的实际量级定阈值，别按默认值猜。

advanced_en.principle: Each epoch the training loop hands the clip-hit share gathered by the optimizer side (optimizer_update._read_clip_ratio_and_reset) to the guard, compares it with the threshold, and resets the accumulator; the two triggers (this field and norm growth) are OR-ed.
advanced_en.intervention: An epoch-boundary decision, one float comparison.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: No compute cost; only the rollback frequency changes.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The log shows the measured clip_ratio and norm_growth -- set the threshold from those numbers rather than guessing around the default.
